worldcombat.skill.freezedry.summary: Freeze the air into a shard of ice and fire it at the target, dealing Ice damage with a chance to freeze it; while frozen it cannot move or act. Water types and soaked bodies take super-effective damage.
worldcombat.skill.freezedry.use.0: Pick off Water types and soaked targets at range
worldcombat.skill.freezedry.use.1: Leave the target unable to act for a while with a freeze
Hits a target for about %1$s special Ice damage and has a %2$s chance to freeze it: while frozen it cannot move or use moves, for up to about 8 seconds, and fire damage breaks the freeze.

Aim at a body or fire in a direction on empty ground. Range %1$s blocks; the shard flies straight at %2$s blocks per tick and can be blocked by cover, with a %3$s block hit radius; with nothing to hit it dissipates at the end of its flight.
worldcombat.skill.freezedry.preference.d: On: power x1.12 and freeze chance from 10% to 18%, but 3 ticks more windup, a slower shard and x1.15 cooldown. Off: a faster shard and a smoother rhythm.
worldcombat.skill.freezedry.preference.a: The companion only considers Freeze-Dry while a target is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger starts sooner.
When on, the companion prioritizes Water types and soaked bodies (super effective); off treats all targets alike.
When on, the companion may leave its post to find a firing line under a Hold order.
Water types and soaked bodies take super-effective damage: Ice is normally only half-effective on Water, but this move turns that into a weakness.
